Bengaluru Delivery Agent Arrested for Alleged Home Invasion and Harassment

A delivery executive in Bengaluru has been arrested after a woman reported he forced his way into her home, used her toilet, and then allegedly exposed himself. The incident came to light when the woman shared her experience and video footage online. Police have registered a case, and the accused has been identified.
